_help: Edit and push; no code changes needed. 'ticker' items rotate in the strip at the top of the page between their start and end times (Central Time offsets). 'dates' feed the Know before you vote timeline. Keep every line short, factual and nonpartisan. Live counts (early votes, top county, results) are added to the ticker automatically.

ticker.text: In-person early voting opens Monday, Oct. 19
Early voting is open through Friday, Oct. 30
Mail ballot applications must be received by Friday, Oct. 23
Bring one of seven approved photo IDs to vote in person
Polls are open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. on Tuesday, Nov. 3
Polls are closed in most of Texas. Early votes post first.

dates.title: Early voting opens
dates.body: Vote at any early voting location in your county.

dates.title: Mail ballot applications due
dates.body: Applications must be received, not postmarked, by this day.

dates.title: Last day of early voting
dates.body: Early voting locations close for the election.

dates.title: Election Day
dates.body: Polls open 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. In line by 7 p.m.? You can still vote. Early and mail votes post first after polls close.
